item.title: Build Automotive Dealership SaaS Platform
item.description: 3000-5000 USD | About the Role We are a growing automotive dealership looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer to architect, build, and scale a custom SaaS platform tailored to our dealership operations. This platform will serve as our central hub to manage vehicle inventory, streamline the sales pipeline, and provide data-driven business insights and recommendations to optimize pricing, stock turnover, and customer engagement. You will have end-to-end ownership of the software lifecycle—from database architecture and backend APIs to building an intuitive, responsive dashboard for our sales and management teams. Key Responsibilities Platform Architecture & Development: Design and build a scalable, cloud-based SaaS web application from the ground up, handling both front-end interfaces and back-end server logic. Inventory & Dealership Management: Develop modules for vehicle inventory tracking (VIN decoding, pricing, vehicle status, service history), customer relationship management (CRM), and deal/sales pipeline tracking. Business Advisory & Analytics Engine: Build real-time reporting dashboards and integrate AI/analytics tools that analyze sales trends, suggest optimal vehicle pricing, and alert management to slow-moving inventory or restocking needs. Third-Party Integrations: Build and maintain APIs to connect with payment gateways (e.g., Stripe), automotive data providers (e.g., VIN decoders, market valuation APIs), accounting tools, and online listing portals. Security & Performance: Ensure fast load times, secure handling of sensitive customer and financial data, role-based access control (for sales reps vs. managers), and reliable cloud deployment. Required Qualifications Experience: 3+ years of proven experience as a Full-Stack Developer building data-driven web applications or SaaS platforms. Front-End Skills: Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as React, Next.js, or Vue.js, along with HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI design. Back-End Skills: Solid experience with server-side technologies such as Node.js, Python (Django/FastAPI), or .NET, and designing RESTful or GraphQL APIs. Database Management: Experience designing and optimizing relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB). Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud hosting and deployment platforms (AWS, Vercel, Google Cloud, or Azure) and version control (Git). Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to translate real-world dealership workflows into clean, user-friendly software features without heavy supervision. Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have) Prior experience building CRM, ERP, inventory management, or e-commerce platforms. Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) to generate automated business insights, pricing recommendations, or customer follow-up drafts. Familiarity with the automotive retail industry or Dealership Management Systems (DMS).

item.title: Build Modern Farm Wordpress Website for flower farm and agri tourism
item.description:
250-750 CAD | Looking for an experienced WordPress & WooCommerce developer to build a clean, modern, fast-loading website from scratch for My Farm, a peony flower farm and agritourism venue in Canada. I already have my brand logo (peony emblem), product list, and photos ready. You have full flexibility to choose a clean, lightweight WooCommerce-compatible WordPress theme (such as Kadence, Blocksy, Astra, or Twenty Twenty-Five), provided the site uses native WordPress blocks so I can easily update seasonal harvest dates, photos, and inventory myself after launch.
​Required Pages & Deliverables: ​1. Header & Navigation: ​Clean transparent/minimal header with the brand logo aligned far left and navigation links (Home, Shop, Checkout) plus cart/account icons aligned far right.
​2. Core Pages: ​Home: Hero section with farm photography, short welcome/story section, featured passes & peony offerings, and clear visitor details. ​Shop / Storefront: Clean WooCommerce catalog organized for Day Passes, Season Passes, Peony Bouquets, and Peony Roots / Live Plants (with future room to add lavender products and gift cards).
​Cart & Checkout: Streamlined, mobile-friendly checkout flow connected to Stripe/Square. ​About / Visit Us: Farm location, visiting guidelines, FAQ, and contact form.
​3. Custom Ticket-Style CTA Buttons: ​Reusable CSS button styling (ticket-btn) featuring notched ticket/coupon edges and a ticket icon for Day Pass and Season Pass call-to-action buttons.
​4. Launch & Handover: ​Full deployment on my Canadian domain and hosting with SSL enabled, basic SEO/speed optimization, mobile responsiveness, and a quick walkthrough showing me how to edit text, swap photos, and manage WooCommerce stock/orders. ​Mandatory Qualifications: ​Strong portfolio of clean, modern WordPress + WooCommerce websites. ​Built with native Gutenberg blocks and clean CSS—no bloated or locked-in page builders so I retain full control for day-to-day updates. ​Strong communication and experience setting up Canadian tax/shipping/pickup options in WooCommerce.
​To Apply, Please Share: ​1. 2–3 links to live WooCommerce websites you built from scratch. ​2. Which WordPress theme you recommend using for this project and why. ​3. Your total fixed price, milestone breakdown, and estimated turnaround time.

item.title: 12-Product Crypto WooCommerce Store
item.description: 1500-3000 AUD | Project Title: WooCommerce Store Build (12 Products, Crypto Checkout, Batch COA QR Codes) – Fixed Price in AUD ​Description: ​Hi, ​We're launching a small online store and need a WooCommerce site built. We are looking for a fixed-price quote in AUD, split into clear milestones. (Please start your bid with the word ATLAS and address all points in the "Please include in your quote" section so we know you've read the full brief.) ​The Project ​A clean, streamlined WooCommerce store selling ~12 research-use-only products. ​We'll share a reference site we like as a guide to layout and feel (we are not asking for an exact copy). ​Clean, modern, mobile-friendly design. We will supply all branding, logos, and product copy. ​What We Need ​1. Core Store Pages: Home, shop, product pages, cart, checkout, about, contact, and policy pages. ​2. Crypto-Only Checkout: BTC and stablecoins (e.g., USDT) via BTCPay Server, NOWPayments, or similar. Please tell us what you've used before and what you recommend. Structure the checkout so standard payment gateways can be easily added later. ​3. Batch QR Codes & COA Pages: Each product page links to a Certificate of Analysis (COA) section/page with a QR code per batch. We need an easy backend workflow to upload a new COA PDF/image and batch number ourselves (a clean Custom Post Type/ACF setup or lightweight plugin is fine). ​4. Automated Supplier Notifications: Each new paid order automatically emails both us and our supplier with the order details and shipping address. ​5. Compliance Features: An 18+ age gate on entry, a "for research purposes only" notice on product pages, and mandatory acknowledgment checkboxes at checkout. ​6. Manual Stock Control: No live inventory counting—just an easy "In Stock / Out of Stock" toggle per product. ​7. Admin & Order Exports: Simple backend to edit products, prices, and pages ourselves, plus 1-click order export to CSV/Excel. ​8. Margin Reporting: Cost-of-goods field per product so we can view profit margins on orders. ​Delivery & Handover ​A staging site for us to review and approve before going live. ​Final deployment on hosting we choose (advice welcome on hosts suited to this niche). ​Full ownership at handover: All admin logins, files, plugins, and licences transferred directly to our accounts. ​A short handover guide or Loom walkthrough video, plus 30 days of post-launch bug-fix support. ​Working Together ​At least 2 hours a week of overlap with Australian Eastern Time (AEST/AEDT). ​Clear English communication and regular milestone updates. ​Please Include in Your Quote ​1. Total fixed price in AUD and proposed milestone breakdown. ​2. Estimated timeline from kickoff to launch. ​3. Which crypto payment plugin you'd use and why. ​4. Links to 2–3 similar WooCommerce stores you've built. ​5. Any ongoing third-party costs (plugins, hosting, licences). ​6. Anything in this brief you'd change or simplify to save time or cost. ​Thanks, and I look forward to hearing from you. ​Dan

item.title: Complete FreeScout Helpdesk Configuration
item.description:

Environment & access • FreeScout must be installed on our OVH server and served securely at help.it with a valid SSL certificate, daily encrypted backups, and hardened security settings. • Visual branding, colours, and logo should match our Digitae style so the experience feels native to customers.
Core functionality Microsoft 365 will power email. I want one shared address that feeds the helpdesk, while staff keep their individual mailboxes for outbound or private replies. FreeScout should generate unique ticket numbers, respect our office-hour SLA rules, and send mobile push notifications.
HubSpot integration HubSpot remains our CRM, but I need FreeScout to create or update HubSpot tickets automatically when new conversations arrive or change state, ensuring full two-way visibility between the systems.
Teams & queues Each of the following groups needs its own helpdesk address and ticket queue so workload and reporting stay separate: • Technical support, sales, and accounts • Technical support, onboarding, and customer success • Technical support, security, and managed services
Feature set Customer portal, knowledge base, time tracking, CSAT surveys, granular reporting and dashboards all have to be enabled and tested.
Deliverables 1. Production-ready FreeScout instance on OVH, fully branded and secured. 2. Microsoft 365 mail routing (shared + individual addresses) tested end-to-end. 3. HubSpot ticket sync configured and verified. 4. Queues and SLAs in place for the three team groups above. 5. Documentation covering server specs, backup routine, and a brief user guide. 6. Final walk-through and hand-over.
Let me know your relevant FreeScout deployments, the estimated cost, and how long you need to complete everything. I’m looking to move quickly once I find the right fit.

item.title: WooCommerce Multi-Vendor Marketplace Specialist
item.description:
30-250 USD | Job Title: WordPress & WooCommerce Marketplace Specialist (Multi-Vendor Storefront) Company: Smart IT
Platform: Naseem Bazaar (naseembazaar.com)
Engagement Type: Ongoing Monthly Retainer / Long-Term Contract
Location: Remote
About Us Smart IT operates Naseem Bazaar, a cross-border multi-vendor fashion marketplace featuring Pakistani clothing brands and independent designers for international buyers across the US, UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Canada, and Australia. Our platform runs on WordPress and WooCommerce with a multi-vendor architecture hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Role Overview We are looking for an experienced, reliable WordPress & WooCommerce Specialist to take ownership of the day-to-day technical operations, maintenance, and optimization of our existing online marketplace. You will be responsible for keeping the storefront fast, secure, and bug-free—managing plugin updates, troubleshooting multi-vendor workflows, maintaining our caching and multi-currency setup, and supporting UI/UX improvements.
Key Responsibilities 1. Core Maintenance, Updates & Security
Safely test and deploy WordPress core, WooCommerce, theme, and third-party plugin updates using a staging environment before pushing to production.
Monitor and patch security vulnerabilities, and resolve PHP fatal errors, plugin conflicts, or broken layouts.
Manage custom code snippets (via the Code Snippets plugin or child theme functions.php) without breaking site functionality.
2. Multi-Vendor (WCFM) & Storefront Operations
Maintain and troubleshoot WCFM Marketplace workflows, including vendor registration, document uploads, vendor approvals, and store profile management.
Manage granular user roles and capabilities (e.g., Store Manager, Store Vendor, custom developer roles) using User Role Editor and WCFM capability settings.
Perform ongoing UI/UX tweaks, page upgrades, and theme customizations (including Slider Revolution and page builders) while ensuring seamless mobile responsiveness on iOS Safari and Chrome.
3. Performance, Caching & Multi-Currency Stability
Maintain and optimize our Redis Object Cache and W3 Total Cache configurations to ensure fast page loads and high uptime.
Ensure FOX Currency Switcher (GeoIP-based multi-currency) works seamlessly with our caching layer so international visitors immediately see accurate local pricing (e.g., SAR for Saudi Arabia) without caching conflicts.
Troubleshoot and resolve catalog pagination issues, cart thumbnail errors, and WooCommerce transients/session bloat.
4. CSV Import Pipeline & Catalog Support
Maintain and troubleshoot bulk product import workflows using WP All Import Pro and WooCommerce CSV tools.
Support custom PHP filters/hooks that enforce draft status on newly imported vendor products and prevent duplicate or unauthorized category creation.
5. Server Health (GCP) & Integrations
Monitor basic server and database health on our GCP Debian VM (Apache, MariaDB, PHP 8.x), including memory limits, upload limits, and automated backup/snapshot verification.
Monitor and debug third-party integrations, including payment gateways, shipping calculators, and marketing tracking setups (Meta Conversions API / TikTok Pixels).
Required Skills & Qualifications 3+ years of hands-on experience managing complex WordPress and WooCommerce stores (multi-vendor marketplace experience is strongly preferred).
Proven expertise with WCFM Marketplace (or similar multi-vendor plugins like Dokan).
Strong proficiency in PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MySQL/MariaDB for custom hooks, snippets, and debugging.
Hands-on experience configuring Redis Object Cache, W3 Total Cache (or similar caching plugins), and resolving caching conflicts with GeoIP multi-currency plugins like FOX Currency Switcher.
Familiarity with WP All Import Pro for handling complex variable product CSVs.
Comfort working with Linux/GCP environments via SSH (checking error logs, managing php.ini/.htaccess, and verifying database health).
Clear, proactive English communication and ability to document maintenance logs and fixes.
How to Apply Please include the following in your proposal:
Relevant Experience: Links to 2–3 WooCommerce stores or multi-vendor marketplaces you have actively maintained or optimized.
Technical Scenario: Briefly explain how you prevent page-caching plugins (like W3 Total Cache) from breaking GeoIP-based multi-currency pricing (like FOX Currency Switcher).
Availability & Rate: Your expected monthly retainer or hourly rate, along with your typical response time for urgent site issues.

item.title: AI-Powered Company Wiki
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I want to spin up a lightweight but reliable internal wiki that answers any employee’s questions instantly, using the content we already store in PDFs, Word docs, and spreadsheets. My preferred engines are Claude and ChatGPT; whichever model we use, the end result should let every team member type a question in plain language and get a clear, cited answer drawn directly from those source files.
Here’s the flow I picture: I drop new documents into a folder or storage bucket, your code ingests and indexes them, and the chat front-end (simple web page is fine) returns answers with references back to the original pages or cells. • upload a fresh file, • ask a question about it minutes later, and • see the answer with a link or snippet that proves where the data came from.

item.title: Automate Legal Documents on WordPress
item.description: 250-750 AUD | Project Brief: Automated Legal Document Production System Project Overview We are looking for an experienced developer to build a simple, cost-effective automated legal document production system for an existing law firm. Important: We already have an existing WordPress website. We do NOT need a new website built. The project involves adding legal services and fixed-fee document packages to the existing WordPress website, allowing clients to purchase services, complete online questionnaires, upload supporting documents and receive professionally prepared legal documents following solicitor approval. We need Stripe integrated into the existing website so clients can select a service, make payment and complete the required onboarding process. We have a strict project budget and are looking for someone who can deliver a practical, reliable solution without unnecessary complexity or expensive custom development. Required Workflow Existing WordPress website: Add legal services and fixed-fee document packages to the existing website, including service descriptions, pricing and inclusions. Online purchasing: Integrate Stripe into the existing WordPress website so clients can purchase their selected legal service. Questionnaire: Following service selection, clients complete an online questionnaire and upload relevant supporting documents. CRM integration and conflict checks: Connect to the firm's existing SILQ CRM to identify existing clients, check relevant parties for potential conflicts and flag potential matches for solicitor review. New client details and approved matters must be saved in SILQ. Conflicts must not be automatically cleared by AI. Engagement and payment: Client receives the relevant costs agreement, accepts the terms and completes payment through Stripe. Matter acceptance and payment must be verified before document production begins. Automation: n8n triggers the workflow following verified payment and the required matter acceptance checks. AI processing: OpenAI extracts and structures client information, while Claude prepares documents using approved legal templates and instructions. Document generation: Generate professionally formatted, branded and fully editable Microsoft Word (.docx) and PDF documents. Solicitor review: Provide a simple, secure interface where solicitors can review documents, download Word/PDF versions, manually edit Word documents and upload revised versions. AI amendments: Solicitors can request AI amendments or make their own manual changes. All document versions must be retained. Final approval: A solicitor must explicitly approve the final document before it can be released. Client delivery: Automatically deliver the approved document securely by email. Feedback: Send an automated client feedback or review request. Required Technology We would prefer to use existing services and avoid unnecessary custom software development. WordPress: Existing website. Add services, purchasing functionality and questionnaires. Stripe: Payment processing integrated into the existing website. n8n: Workflow automation. SILQ: Existing CRM and legal practice management system. OpenAI API: Information extraction. Claude API: Legal document drafting. Microsoft Word (.docx) and PDF: Document generation. Important Requirements Work with our existing WordPress website. Do not rebuild it. Add legal services and fixed-fee packages to the existing website. Allow clients to purchase services, complete questionnaires and upload documents online. Integrate Stripe for secure payments. Integrate with the firm's existing SILQ CRM. Do not build another CRM. Support client searches, potential conflict identification and new client/matter creation, subject to SILQ API capabilities. Maintain secure document storage and client confidentiality. Provide downloadable and editable Word documents. Allow solicitors to manually amend and re-upload documents. Maintain document version history. Require solicitor approval before documents are sent to clients. Include basic error handling and workflow notifications. Budget, Scope and Proposal We have a strict budget for this project and are looking for the most affordable practical solution. If you are interested in bidding, please provide: Your best fixed-price quote for delivering the project. A clear breakdown of exactly what is included in your proposed scope. Your estimated development timeframe and delivery milestones. Any additional ongoing costs, including hosting, API usage, subscriptions or third-party services. Confirmation that you have experience with WordPress, Stripe, n8n, API integrations, AI document generation and CRM integrations. Any recommendations for simplifying the implementation or reducing costs without compromising essential functionality. Please distinguish between essential functionality and optional enhancements. We are open to practical alternatives if they achieve the same outcome at a lower cost. Our preference is a straightforward, reliable and affordable solution that builds on our existing WordPress website rather than creating an entirely new platform.
